marketProvenance.format: Dynasty Rookie; explicit 1QB; 10-team article reference; no TEP statement
marketProvenance.normalizationMethod: Published overall rank was preserved as integer expected overall pick; no round-label conversion was applied. The source is explicitly 10-team, so its overall-pick expectation is compared directly against the 12-team LCC overall pick.
marketProvenance.normalizationDisclosure: Published overall rank was preserved as integer expected overall pick; no round-label conversion was applied. The source is explicitly 10-team, so its overall-pick expectation is compared directly against the 12-team LCC overall pick.
marketProvenance.licensingUseNotes: Public article table preserved from browser-accessible content; no paywall, authentication, or subscriber dataset was bypassed.

disclosure: This is a retrospective simulation of what the current Draft Intelligence methodology would have produced using the approved historical evidence and market references. It was not an actual forecast created in that season.
historicalEvidenceBoundary: Each owner evaluation retains its original draft-time analysisAsOf and draft-time evidence boundary; no later Outcome, current roster, current market, or current ADP data is admitted.

evidence.CAPITAL_DEPLOYMENT: Deployment quality scored from use of the actual 4 selection(s); inventory facts are contextual only.
evidence.ROSTER_CONTEXT: 1 thin position(s) addressed; 1 addressed with early capital; 0 thin position(s) untouched.
evidence.DRAFT_CONSTRUCTION: 1 early and 3 late selection(s) across 3 used round(s); position diversity is excluded from this dimension.
evidence.CONCENTRATION_BALANCE: Maximum same-position share was 2/4; structural concentration is scored here.
evidence.OPTIONALITY_DEPTH_BUILDING: 3 distinct positional path(s), with 2 late-round position(s); breadth is scored here.

limitations: Roster context is an identity bridge from preserved prior-season snapshots and commissioner screenshot evidence; screenshot completeness is not proven.
Historical NFL team metadata and later transactions are excluded from this draft-day evaluation.
